master.definition_en: Urachal cancer is a type of bladder cancer, making up less than 1% of all bladder cancers. The urachus is a structure normally only present during development in the womb that connects the bellybutton and the bladder. This connection normally disappears before birth, but in some people remains. Urachalcancers are usually diagnosed in adults in their 50's and 60's and may develop at the dome or anterior wall of the bladder, along the midline of the body (including the belly button), and between the pubis symphasis and the bladder.Most urachal cancersare adenocarcinomas (cancers that develop from gland cells).Others may besarcomas (which develop from connective tissue -such as leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and malignant fibrous histiocytoma), small cell carcinomas, transitional cell cancer, and mixed neoplasias. Most individuals with urachal cancer have symptoms of with hematuria (blood in urine). Other symptoms may include abdominal pain, a palpable abdominal mass, mucinuria, and bacteriuria. Treatment usually involved surgery to remove the cancer.

master.definition_en: Mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD) is a rare autoimmune disorder that is characterized by features commonly seen in three different connective tissue disorders: systemic lupus erythematosus, scleroderma, and polymyositis. Some affected people may also have symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis. Although MCTD can affect people of all ages, it appears to be most common in women under age 30. Signs and symptoms vary but may include Raynaud's phenomenon ; arthritis; heart, lung and skin abnormalities; kidney disease; muscle weakness, and dysfunction of the esophagus. The cause of MCTD is currently unknown. There is no cure but certain medications such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), corticosteroids and immunosuppresivedrugsmay help manage the symptoms.

mechanisms: Inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa B kinase beta subunit inhibitor

Additional manifestations may include mild to moderate developmental delay, mild facial dysmorphic features (such as dysplastic ears), and anomalies of bones, teeth, and nails.
synonyms_en: recurrent infection due to specific granule deficiency
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 头颈部实体瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 多数呈亚急性至慢性进展（病程数月至数年），早期常仅表现为回吸涕中带血、单侧耳闷/耳鸣或无痛性颈部淋巴结肿大，极易被误诊为鼻炎或中耳炎；肿瘤向上侵犯颅底可致剧烈头痛、复视及脑神经麻痹，晚期放疗后颈部血管坏死或肿瘤破溃可突发致命性大出血（颈动脉破裂出血可在数分钟内危及生命）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 对放疗高度敏感，是头颈肿瘤中治愈率最高的类型之一：Ⅰ–Ⅱ期单纯调强放疗(IMRT)5年生存率可达85%–95%；局部晚期通过诱导化疗+同步放化疗+PD-1免疫联合治疗，5年生存率仍达75%–85%；复发/转移性患者依靠吉西他滨+顺铂联合特瑞普利单抗/替雷利珠单抗等免疫治疗可显著延长生存。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 鼻咽大出血/放疗后假性动脉瘤破裂：立即保持头低侧卧位防窒息，紧急前/后鼻孔填塞压迫，同步120送有介入条件医院行急诊数字减影血管造影(DSA)覆膜支架植入或弹簧圈栓塞，严禁盲目强行拔除鼻腔填塞物; 2) 急性气道梗阻或严重张口困难伴窒息风险：立即评估行气管切开术建立气道; 3) 颅底侵犯伴急性颅高压/脑神经危象：予甘露醇脱水及糖皮质激素减轻瘤周水肿并急诊放疗评估。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 马骏院士团队CONTINUUM与DIPPER等3期临床证实局部晚期鼻咽癌放化疗联合PD-1单抗（信迪利单抗/卡瑞利珠单抗）显著降低远处转移并提升3年无事件生存率至86%以上；2) 特瑞普利单抗(JUPITER-02)及派安普利单抗(Penpulimab, 2025年4月获FDA批准)确立复发转移鼻咽癌免疫联合化疗国际标准；3) 血浆游离EBV-DNA片段组学与甲基化AI早筛模型将华南高危人群早期检出率提升至80%以上；4) 针对TROP2/EGFR-HER3双抗ADC(如BL-B01D1)及EBV特异性TCR-T/CAR-T细胞疗法在铂耐药人群展现高缓解率。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 放疗后长期口干、听力下降、吞咽困难及放射性脑损伤等远期毒副反应仍明显影响生存质量; 2) 免疫及铂类耐药后的复发转移患者缺乏高有效率后线标准方案; 3) 华南以外地区基层对无痛性颈部淋巴结肿大与回吸涕血的早期识别率仍偏低。

master.definition_en: Papular xanthoma is a form of non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis characterized by cutaneous presentation of solitary or disseminated yellow to orange-brown papular or papulonodular, noncoalescent, asymptomatic skin lesions located predominantly on the head, neck, trunk and extremities (rarely on oral mucosa), in the presence of normolipidemia. Microscopically, the lesions consist of monomorphous infiltrate of xanthomatized macrophages and numerous Touton giant cells, with scant or absent inflammatory infiltrate. It is usually not associated with systemic disease.
